title: Happy Girl Jeannie Holding Doll Outdoors, 1964 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square-format black and white snapshot from December 1964 showing a smiling young girl identified as Jeannie standing outdoors under dappled tree shadows. She wears a sleeveless summer play top with matching shorts, dark sneakers with white socks, and holds a fashion doll close to her chest. Tall pines or outdoor woodland brush appear in the sunlit background, capturing an intimate glimpse of mid-1960s American childhood play and leisure.
